I love this app!. I just, like two weeks ago just, started doing yoga at 47! I was very nervous and did not have anywhere near me to take classes. I am a stay at home mom and have gotten so out of shape over the past 9 years of not physically working a job. This app walked me through each step before I did it, and has different workouts for different levels. I love that it gives you an option for the voice you want to hear instructing you. You also get a choice of background music. I was absolutely amazed by how much better I feel just by stretching my body. I started with a quick 5 min session for a few days, now I’m up to two full sessions a day plus the sleeping routine. I must say I am really impressed. Overall the cost is way cheaper than going to a gym or a yoga studio would be and I don’t have to worry about someone else watching me while I learn.

Encouraging. I have had several yoga apps - I am middle aged woman with a sedentary job. I was having chronic back pain and mobility was severely declining due to nerve pain. I am unable to take pain meds and reluctantly tried yoga again. This App showed up in my search, before writing review I have been using it for about 6 months. Slow progression sections are perfect for growing abilities and building habits. 

I am now on advanced. It’s very challenging but my mobility has me feeling 10 years younger. 

There has been several app updates but my progress was not affected (other apps erased my progress- it was so frustrating) adding new sections keeps things fresh.

Helpful articles and tips found at bottom of page. I haven’t tried the specific body focus programs yet. Just getting my mobility back has been incredible. This app is well laid out and has options for many levels of ability. When you have become better able to move from one pose to another you can reduce the rest time. There is also a section now to follow progress and graph weight. 

Overall I am very pleased with this app and the continued updates. Will definitely keep subscription.

Does not offer alternative exercises or modifications for injuries. There are many things I really enjoy about this app. However, it does not accommodate for injuries. 

I have two frozen shoulders from which I’m recovering and I can’t do the majority of these yoga exercises that require my arms to be fully straighten up. There are no modifications offered for such a situation. 

It would be nice if this had some sort of questionnaire prior to beginning a work out that asked questions about injuries and such. Then form a workout based around those injuries and offer modifications.

SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED.. Don’t listen to the other older reviews. I just tried this, and didn’t even get to see what type of routines it was going to suggest before I was asked to buy a subscription. I wanted the convenience of having an app for yoga on my phone, so I didn’t have to lug my laptop room to room, and can easily track my workouts. But I can buy a notebook to log workouts for under a buck and watch YouTube routines from trainers for free. Why would I pay for this? 

And why is the top review completely lying about this not requiring a payment to access? Why are several reviews doing this? You get to create a little profile and answer some questions, but you don’t actually get to see or do any workouts until you pay. Just your name, BMI and measurements, goals, etc. It seems like many people are getting misled and even accidentally purchasing the year subscription for like $60-70, because it’s a bit confusing: it shows you two payment sub options, and underneath, a continue button that implies you don’t need to select one and will be taken to your workout page. This is false. It’s pre-selected the year subscription with a 3 day trial. This seems like a scam, and if it’s not, why wouldn’t you just rectify this issue so people stop having issues and complaining?

reviews.text: Changed my life!. I began using this app in February after having a sever case of COVID with double Pneumonia. I had lost lung capacity and couldn’t breathe throughout the day without coughing.I thank God for discovering it when I did. I thought yoga was a joke prior to the app. I stayed committed to do it daily and have continued to do so. I’m in awe!! I’m 61 years old and feel better than I did in my 30’s. People tell me I’m aging in reverse. My flexibility it’s now amazing, I’m sleeping great and have so much energy! I was diagnosed with scoliosis at 16 and my back has actually started to straighten!!! It is visible!! I’ve become more mindful and have regained full lung capacity. My body has transformed as well, and I’m more shapely than I have been in years. Since I started, I’ve maintained a 125-127lb weight! I share this app with everyone! I even have my husband doing it with me and we love it! Creators of “yoga” app, you rock! Thank you!
